instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: “What happened, Estefania?” Coto asked. Estefania seemed to be very upset and was sitting by herself under the tree that was in both of their front gardens. Estefania is Coto’s neighbour when he and his parents visit Guaytacama Parish in Ecuador. They have been friends for years.

atoms.a: How do Coto and Estefania know each other?
atoms.sound: How do Kohtoh and Estefania know each other?

atoms.text: “I can’t find my shawl. It was my grandmothers and is part of my traditional outfit for the Independence Day celebration next week. My mum is going to be so upset with me!” said Estefania before starting to cry. “I can’t believe I lost it! It was in my room only yesterday.”

My mum is going to be so upset with me!” </voice>said Estefania before starting to cry. <voice voice='f1'>“I can’t believe I lost it! It was in my room only yesterday.” </voice>

atoms.text: Coto offered Estefania a hug. “Maybe it will turn up. I know, let’s try to find it together! Let’s retrace your steps.” Estefania looked a little happier. “If you last saw it in your room, let’s start there.”

atoms.a: Choose the statement that contrasts Estefania’s feelings before and after Coto gave her a hug.
atoms.sound: Choose the statements that contrast Estefania’s feelings before and after Kohtoh gave her a hug
atoms.hint: When we contrast, we find what makes two or more things different.
b: She seems even more sad than before.

atoms.a: Why does Estefania need her shawl?

atoms.text: Coto and Estefania looked through her room. They opened every drawer and checked in, on and under the bed. No luck. Coto sat on the window ledge and thought some more. In August, the window was always open as it was very warm. He glanced back and just so happened to see some kind of animal print in the mud under the window.
atoms.sound: ssml: Kohtoh and Estefania looked through her room. They opened every drawer and checked in, on, and under the bed. No luck. Kohtoh sat on the window ledge and thought some more. In August, the window was always open as it was very warm. He glanced back and just so happened to see some kind of animal print in the mud under the window.

atoms.text:
“Look!” said Coto pointing down. “Estefania, there was an animal right here under your window. It rained two days ago, so it must have been made yesterday, the same day your shawl went missing!” Coto sounded very excited.
“Are you thinking an animal took my shawl? I don’t know, Coto. That sounds pretty strange.” They went outside and stood above the print trying to make out what had made it. The mud was very dark, and it was very hard to see it clearly.

atoms.a: Choose the statement that compares Estefania’s and Coto’s reaction to the animal print.
atoms.sound: Choose the statement that compares Estefania’s and Kohtoh’s reaction to the animal print.
atoms.hint: When we compare, we find how two or more things are similar.
b: ++They both went to look at the print more closely.

atoms.a: Choose the statement that contrasts Estefania’s and Coto’s reaction to the animal print.
atoms.sound: Choose the statement that contrasts Estefania’s and Kohtoh’s reaction to the animal print.
atoms.hint: When we contrast, we find what makes two or more things different.
b: Estefania was convinced right away that an animal had stolen her shawl, while Coto thought that was less likely.
++Estefania thought Coto’s idea was strange, but Coto was excited about his idea.
